name: dbt-quality
description: dbt quality tooling for Snowflake: a project-wide anti-pattern audit that produces an HTML quality assessment with prioritised remediation, and per-file validation on save. Covers project fragmentation, truncate/delete-load instead of incremental models, subqueries that should be CTEs or ephemeral models, macro over- and under-use, materialization fitness, test and documentation coverage, and unresolved lift-and-shift conversion debt. Installs two hooks: per-file validation on Write/Edit, and an advisory project audit that runs after dbt updates the manifest.
